tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The D CORE 2U 19in X23RM Industrial Storage Rack Mount Black Case is a robust and space-efficient rackmount chassis designed for servers, storage systems, NVRs, and industrial IT applications. Built with heavy-duty steel and a standard 19-inch rack form factor, this 2U rackmount case ensures durability, excellent airflow, and reliable performance in data centers and professional environments.


The D CORE 2U 19-Inch X23RM Industrial Storage Rack Mount Black Case is engineered for professional server and storage installations where reliability and space optimization are essential. Its compact 2U design allows efficient rack usage while maintaining excellent airflow for stable system operation.


Designed for compatibility with standard 19-inch racks, this rackmount case is suitable for enterprise servers, network storage, surveillance systems, and industrial computing environments. The strong steel construction and clean black finish make it an ideal choice for data centers, telecom rooms, and IT infrastructure projects in Bangladesh.


Key Features


  • Standard 2U height compatible with 19-inch server racks
  • Industrial-grade steel body for long-term durability
  • Black professional finish suitable for data centers
  • Supports server, storage, NAS, and NVR systems
  • Efficient ventilation design for optimal cooling
  • Front panel power & LED indicators
  • Ideal for enterprise, ISP, and industrial deployments
